patterns.note: Full-bleed, edge-to-edge project imagery dominates the viewport, creating an immersive gallery experience as the primary content.
A minimalist, fixed header navigation with left and right-aligned text links persists at the top of the page, maintaining context during scroll.
A high-contrast dark mode palette uses a deep charcoal background with crisp white typography, making the project images pop.
Large project images sequentially reveal from the bottom as the user scrolls, smoothly transitioning new content into the viewport.
The top navigation bar and a subtle scroll progress indicator remain sticky at the top of the page, providing constant access and orientation.
Project titles use a clean, medium-weight sans-serif, complemented by smaller, lighter-weight sans-serif text for location and client details, maintaining a sophisticated hierarchy.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation is implemented, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport during scroll, along with a subtle scroll progress indicator for user orientation.

Content sections, primarily large, full-width project images with descriptive text overlays, are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, creating a continuous, uninterrupted visual flow.
The site utilizes a dark, full-bleed background that provides a stark contrast for the white typography and vibrant project photography, enhancing visual impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Moderately sized, clean sans-serif headings for project titles, with smaller, lighter-weight sans-serif for descriptive text and uppercase labels.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its immersive, full-bleed image gallery presented as a continuous vertical scroll, where each project image takes center stage against a stark, dark background. This creates a highly focused and dramatic presentation of the portfolio, emphasizing the visual impact of the work.
